notes: Read SKILL.md in full. A worker playbook for paying down Python typing debt: remove assigned modules from the mypy exclusion list in pyproject.toml, fix the surfaced type errors, run targeted mypy, pytest and pre-commit, and return a fixed-format batch summary.

Medium because it edits source files and pyproject.toml and runs the project's own tooling (mypy, pytest, `pre-commit run --files`, SKILL.md:41-57), which executes repository test code and pre-commit hooks that may download hook environments on first run. Acceptable: this is the developer's own repository and task, scope is restricted to assigned modules (SKILL.md:28-33), it requires the assignment inputs before editing (SKILL.md:17-26), and it stops instead of widening scope (SKILL.md:105-111); it does not commit, push or touch credentials.
Designed for an orchestrated multi-worker setup ('manager/orchestrator', worktree/branch inputs) but works standalone when the user supplies the module list. No external files are required.
